ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, gérants and authorized signatories against: (i) TRACFIN French targeted financial sanctions and suspicious-activity indicators; (ii) EU consolidated financial sanctions lists and French DG Trésor asset-freeze decisions; (iii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions; (iv) US OFAC SDN, non-SDN and sectoral sanctions lists; and (v) French domestic PEP definitions under Article L561-10-2 of the Code monétaire et financier. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, family member or close associate, for any high-risk third-country connection, and whenever the dried goji berry / herbal wholesale activity touches sanctioned jurisdictions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (INPI) — formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; national registry availability check via Infogreffe and the RCS (Registre du commerce et des sociétés).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory corporate documents and filings must be in French. The company name may be in a foreign language but must use Latin script and be distinctive within the Registre National des Entreprises. If the name uses non-Latin characters, a French or Latin-alphabet transliteration must be filed and used. The proposed name must not create confusion with existing trademarks, domain names, or RCS-registered company names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the INPI or the competent greffe rejects a name, the incorporator may amend the dossier and resubmit; an administrative reconsideration request may be filed with the registrar within 15 days of rejection, and an appeal lies to the supervising judge of the tribunal de commerce (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) within one month. For rejection based on trademark collision, the incorporator may provide a consent letter from the opposing trademark owner or choose a revised name. No statutory extension of the initial 30-day reservation window is available; after expiry, a fresh reservation application must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only through a licensed commercial domiciliation company under Articles L123-10 and R123-16-1 of the French Code de commerce. The virtual office must provide a genuine physical French address for service of process, inspection of statutory records, and tax / URSSAF correspondence. A stand-alone PO box or a purely virtual mailbox is not acceptable for a SARL engaged in wholesale distribution of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate; approximately 20% probability of unannounced inspection by commercial registry inspectors, tax authorities or URSSAF within the first 18 months, increasing to approximately 35% if a third-party domiciliation address is used or customs-controlled herbal / botanical imports are frequent.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Book II Title III (Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43; R.223-1 to R.223-29) and implementing order; entered into force under Law No. 98-546.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (Commercial Court Registry) operating the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: M0 format declaration accompanied by the Articles of Association (statuts) and supporting formation dossiers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital threshold; the shareholders freely fix the capital. Cash contributions must be released in at least one-fifth immediately and deposited into a blocked account or a French bank; the remaining balance must be paid within five years. In-kind contributions are fully subscribed and released as assessed by the commissaire aux apports.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned founders and initial shareholders of [Company], adopt this First Board Resolution to formalize incorporation steps. Resolved: (1) the subscription of the initial share capital is ratified, each founder having subscribed the shares allotted in the Society's incorporation deed; (2) the registered office is fixed at [address], within the validity of the local business domiciliation certificate; (3) the first manager(s) are appointed with powers to direct ordinary corporate purposes and legal representation; and (4) all formation filings, publication of notices, and representations before the Commercial Registry are authorized and approved. This Resolution takes effect upon signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, execute and deposit Articles of Association and shareholder subscription schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders and, if applicable, a French notarial office; capital deposit with a French bank or Caisse des Dépôts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Association containing the SARL name, duration, corporate object, registered office, capital amount, share allocation, first manager(s), and powers. Each shareholder signs the deed and subscribes shares. For cash capital, at least one-fifth must be paid into a blocked account in the company name. For in-kind contributions, have a commissaire aux apports value the contribution and attach the report to the statuts.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Articles of Association (two originals for commercial registry filing, if applicable)
Share subscription schedules signed by all founders
Identity documents and address certificates for each shareholder
Statement of actual beneficiary ownership
Commissaire aux apports report for in-kind contributions, if applicable
Bank certificate attesting the deposit of paid-up cash capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any formal defect in the statuts and signature pages; re-execute the deed if notarization is required; issue a supplementary resolution curing incomplete contributions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal publication of the formation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An authorized Journal d'annonces légales in the department where the registered office is situated.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft a legal notice containing the company name, legal form 'SARL', capital amount, registered office, corporate object, duration, manager(s), and RCS registration city. Submit to the chosen authorized JAL and obtain the certificate of publication. Retain a copy of the notice for the registry file.
required_dossiers: Completed legal notice form
Text of mandatory announcement items
Draft first board resolution appointing managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the announcement if the registry or JAL requires changes; purchase a corrected publication certificate and append it to the filing dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit formation file to the Commercial Registry through the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises, forwarded to the Greffe du tribunal de commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the official Guichet unique portal, complete the M0 registration form, upload the statuts, capital deposit certificate, publication notice, beneficial owner statement, and manager declarations. Pay the registry and state levies. Ensure all attachments are electronically transmitted before the registry deadline.
required_dossiers: M0 standardized form
Certified copy of Articles of Association
Bank certificate of capital deposit or notary's certificate
Legal announcement publication certificate
Manager(s) appointment resolution and declaration of absence of incompatibility
Beneficial ownership declaration
List of managers' identity documents and home addresses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any registry observation within 15 days through the Guichet unique; file a corrected version of the deficient document; obtain a provisional SIREN number to track the dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry legal review and issuance of corporate identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce in connection with the Registre du commerce et des sociétés and INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registry verifies the legal regularity of the statuts, capital release, and form declarations. Upon approval, the company receives its K-bis extract, SIREN/SIRET number, and trading category. The compañía acquires legal personality on the date of registry registration.
required_dossiers: No additional external submission; registry relies on the M0 file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry refuses registration for an irregularity, request an explanation and file a curative act; seek recourse before the president of the commercial court under Article R.123-145 of the Commercial Code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete social, fiscal, food-health, and industrial operational declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, Service des impôts des entreprises, DGCCRF, DRIEETS/DDETS, and local fire-prevention authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company and its manager with URSSAF for employee status and social protection. Obtain the SIRET establishment registration. For dried goji berries and herbal botanicals for human consumption, file a food business operator declaration (déclaration d'activité sanitaire) with the DGCCRF or competent protection agency. Register the premises with occupational cleanliness and fire-safety authorities as required for warehousing.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Manager's identity and proof of address
Registered office lease or domiciliation certificate
Food business operator declaration (déclaration d'activité sanitaire)
Fire safety and occupational workplace declarations, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the food-health declaration is rejected, provide an additional hygiene protocol and environmental risk analysis; resubmit through the teleprocedure or seek advice from the local DRIEETS to correct technical omissions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction générale de la concurrence, de la consommation et de la répression des fraudes (DGCCRF); Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) for environmental police.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Déclaration d'activité sanitaire for plant-based foodstuffs (Code rural et de la pêche maritime, Art. L.233-2) and, if applicable, organic operation certificate delivered under EU Regulation 2018/848 and supervised by INAO.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL - Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement, Inspection des installations classées.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – Exempt from full EIA; registration or simple declaration applies for dried botanical warehousing below the ICPE threshold (Rubrique 1510). No formal EIA report is required for ordinary storage of packaged dry plant products below 500 tonnes effective storing capacity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must satisfy the threshold values of Arrêté du 31 mars 1980 and the Code de l'environnement (Art. L.1331-1). VOC emissions, if any, must remain under 2 tonnes per year in accordance with EU Directive 2016/2284; otherwise, an ICPE authorization and atmospheric emission monitoring are triggered. Discarded packaging and plant waste must be transferred to registered waste collectors with documented waste-dispatch dossiers (bordereau de suivi de déchets) for any hazardous residual.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate delivered by the local commission de sécurité (or SDIS) for storage premises exceeding 500 m², including an approved emergency plan, fire extinguishers, and smoke-detection signage; structural soundness certificate prepared by an approved building engineer; and an occupational workplace clearance issued by the DDETS/DRIEETS confirming compliance with health and labor inspection standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — taxpayer portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr; business formalities portal https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique operated by INPI); local competent office: Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the registered office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SARL, the legal representative files the incorporation and registration dossier with the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). DGFiP assigns the SIREN number, SIRET establishments, and the French VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire: FR + 2-digit key + SIREN). Foreign non-established entities making taxable supplies in France must file a direct VAT registration (simplified form CERFA, Service des Impôts des Entreprises) and obtain a French VAT number from the first euro of French taxable activity; exporters use this number to zero-rate exports and recover input VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (opaque SARL subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at 25% standard rate; reduced 15% rate on taxable profits up to EUR 42,500 per fiscal year under art. 219 CGI); territorial scope: world-wide profits for a French-resident SARL subject to the foreign PE exception (art. 209 I CGI); no tax-exempt zone status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in France. Options available: (i) family SARL election under art. 239 bis AA CGI to be taxed transparently at the partner level (impôt sur le revenu), available only for SARLs whose capital is held by related individuals; (ii) tax consolidation (intégration fiscale, art. 223 A CGI) for a 95%-controlled French group; (iii) optional 5-year alignment of accounting year-end (art. 208 CGI). Hybrid mismatch rules (art. 212 bis, 209 B CGI, ATAD 2016/1164) restrict deduction/non-inclusion outcomes and reverse mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 85,000 annual turnover for supplies of goods under the franchise-en-base exemption (art. 293 B CGI applies to established businesses); foreign non-established entities and exporters must register for French VAT from the first euro of taxable French supplies — no threshold applies. Cross-border wholesale exports of goods are outside the French turnover threshold and are zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory nationwide B2B e-invoicing and cross-border e-reporting under the 2024-2025 budget law, phased in from 1 September 2026 (large/medium enterprises) and 1 September 2027 (SMEs including SARLs). Invoices must be exchanged via the Public Invoicing Portal (Portail Public de Facturation - PPF) or a certified PDP (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) using structured formats (Factur-X, UBL, CII); export transactions are transmitted as e-reporting data to DGFiP through the PPF/PDP APIs. France uses continuous transaction controls for reporting, not per-invoice fiscal stamping/real-time authorisation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods dispatched outside the EU qualify for VAT exemption with credit (0%) under art. 262-I-1° CGI, provided the goods leave the French or EU customs territory within 90 days of dispatch and the supplier holds proof of shipment in its commercial file; ancillary services (freight, customs handling) linked to exported goods and certain services to non-EU business customers are also zero-rated under art. 259 A/B CGI. Dried goji berries and processed herbal botanicals (ISIC 4631) exported in bulk qualify as physical goods; the exporter retains the right to deduct input VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU / e-Export via DELTA-X)
Bill of Lading (or CMR / Air Waybill) evidencing physical exit
SWIFT MT103 / Inward Remittance Certificate as payment proof
EUR.1 movement certificate or REX statement for preferential origin claims
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP audits the complete export file, the 90-day exit deadline and the consistency of customs status with transport and payment flows. If export evidence is missing or fraudulent, the VAT is retroactively claimed (clawback with issuance of VAT assessment), input VAT credits are denied, and penalties apply: 80% of the tax for bad faith or manoeuvres fraudulentes (art. 1729 CGI), 40% late-payment interest, and up to 100% additional penalty for fraud (art. 1729-0 CGI). Criminal fines apply under the customs code for false declarations; failure to repatriate FX proceeds within 150 days exposes the exporter to administrative penalties and foreign-exchange irregularities under art. R561-5 CMF.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The European Central Bank (ECB) conducts euro-area monetary policy. Banque de France is France’s national central bank and participates in the Eurosystem. France has no general foreign-exchange administration imposing routine exchange controls; the Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI) administers customs and certain reporting obligations, not general FX permissions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is freely convertible. France and the EU generally permit current-account and capital-account payments and transfers, subject to EU sanctions, anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing controls, tax rules, banking due diligence, and any applicable reporting requirements. A French SARL may receive foreign investment, pay foreign suppliers, and remit lawfully distributable profits abroad without a general FX approval. Dividend distributions remain subject to French corporate-law procedures, distributable-profit and reserve tests, withholding-tax rules, treaty or EU relief conditions, and required tax documentation. Banks may request contracts, invoices, ownership information, source-of-funds evidence, and payment-purpose details.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio or general deadline requiring export receipts to be converted into euros. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency, subject to bank terms, accounting and tax requirements, sanctions screening, and any transaction-specific reporting duties. EU and French cash-control declarations apply to qualifying physical movements of cash or bearer instruments across relevant borders; they do not constitute an export-receipt conversion rule.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for supplementary payment services, subject to the provider’s geographic eligibility, French or EEA authorization/passporting, permitted account features, safeguarding model, and risk appetite. An electronic-money institution account is not necessarily a bank deposit, may not provide a French IBAN or full trade-finance services, and may restrict high-value commodity, third-country, or cash-intensive flows. Use a regulated bank as the principal operating and trade-finance relationship; verify the provider’s status in the relevant regulator register before onboarding.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no general statutory requirement that every SARL director appear physically at a bank branch. Banks determine whether onboarding can be completed remotely, require an in-person or video interview, or request original or certified documents. Non-resident directors, complex ownership, higher-risk countries, or unusual payment flows commonly trigger enhanced verification. Confirm the selected bank’s current requirements before incorporation or account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership, nominee arrangements, layered holding companies, or difficulty identifying natural-person beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current group organization chart to natural persons; company registry extracts and constitutional documents for each entity; shareholder register; beneficial-owner declarations and applicable French beneficial-ownership filings; identity and address evidence; ownership and control explanation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign capital or shareholder funding with unexplained source of funds, source of wealth, or third-party remitter.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment or shareholder-loan agreement; board or shareholder resolutions; originating account statement; audited financial statements, sale or dividend records, or other source-of-wealth evidence; remitter identity and relationship evidence; payment instructions matching the legal funding instrument.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value or unusual cross-border payments, mismatched payer and buyer, or payment descriptions inconsistent with the SARL’s stated botanical wholesale activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed purchase and sale contracts; commercial invoices; purchase orders; shipping and insurance documents; customs declarations and import/export evidence; counterparty KYC; explanation of any third-party payment; reconciliation of invoice, shipment, and bank amounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure, counterparties or banks in restricted jurisdictions, or beneficial owners with politically exposed person status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented sanctions and PEP screening results; ownership and control analysis; customer and supplier due diligence; end-use and destination evidence; legal review of applicable EU and French restrictions; bank pre-clearance where appropriate. Do not process a prohibited transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Organic, herbal, or food-trade activity unsupported by credible product, supplier, or regulatory documentation, or transactions inconsistent with declared business scope.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier and customer contracts; product specifications and botanical identification; invoices and traceability records; applicable organic certification and control-body evidence; food-safety, customs, and import documentation; evidence of required registrations or authorizations for the specific products and activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Fund the SARL from an account held in the investor’s or lender’s own name, using a regulated bank and a payment reference identifying the SARL and the legal basis, such as share subscription, share premium, or shareholder loan. For a share subscription requiring a blocked capital account, arrange the depositary bank’s prescribed process and obtain the deposit certificate for incorporation; release funds after registration and satisfaction of the bank’s conditions. There is no universal French FX purpose-code system for ordinary commercial wires. Provide the bank with the subscription or loan documents, corporate resolutions, investor identity and beneficial-owner evidence, source-of-funds materials, and any requested tax or regulatory forms. Use SEPA Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments and SWIFT cross-border transfers where appropriate; confirm charges, correspondent-bank details, and beneficiary-account information before sending.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For euro payments within SEPA, use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant where supported and suitable. For other currencies or jurisdictions, use a bank wire through SWIFT; payment messages are subject to the applicable SWIFT/ISO 20022 implementation and the sending bank’s processes. Match each payment to the underlying contract, invoice, purchase order, shipment, and customs records, and screen counterparties and banks for sanctions. Documentary credits may be issued or advised through the relationship bank under agreed terms, commonly incorporating ICC UCP 600 when expressly specified. Agree currency, settlement date, correspondent charges, document standards, discrepancy handling, and Incoterms in the contract. Do not describe a payment as a commercial letter of credit unless the issuing bank has formally issued one.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards with an authorized bank or investment firm, documented against forecast or committed commercial exposures and subject to the provider’s suitability, appropriateness, credit, and collateral requirements.

Non-deliverable forwards only where the currency, counterparty, product terms, and applicable regulatory requirements permit; settlement is typically by net cash difference and does not replace the underlying trade payment.

Foreign-exchange swaps and cross-currency swaps with an authorized counterparty, subject to documented treasury purpose, counterparty limits, collateral terms, and applicable EMIR reporting, clearing, risk-mitigation, and recordkeeping obligations.
Spot FX conversion through a regulated bank or authorized payment provider; compare quoted spreads, fees, settlement timing, and beneficiary delivery terms.
